Write down your recovery code

Use this code to turn the PIN lock off if you forget your PIN. It is shown once. Keep it somewhere safe.

Save this file somewhere safe. The browser can request a download but cannot verify that the file was saved.

Settings

Optional PIN lock

Off by default. A PIN prevents casual use of the interface; saved data and backup files are not encrypted.

Defaults

Data saving

Saved records and settings are stored automatically in this browser on this computer. Use Save, Add Draft or Issue to commit an entry; unfinished form edits are not automatically saved. Backups are additional recovery copies.

Backup & Restore

Keep an additional recovery copy of your saved data. Backup buttons are not needed to save normal work. Recovery codes are saved separately.

Automatic Folder Backup — optional

Automatically keeps recovery copies in your selected folder for the last 30 days. Saved records remain stored on this computer when this option is off. Closing the browser may interrupt a folder backup.

Data reset

Clear selected data (register, beneficiaries, templates, accounts, preferences...) or everything. A safety backup is offered first.

Storage

Records are kept in this browser's own database. cheqprinter sets no limit on cheques, beneficiaries or history; the only limit is free space on this computer. This is information only.
